OBIS occurrences: Psychropotes longicauda (W Pacific box 0-35N 120-160E)

visual.coloration: Dark body perched on elongated pelvic and tail fin rays; sensory pectoral rays spread forward.

adaptation: Stands on stilt-like fin rays facing the current, intercepting drifting prey.
notes: Genus-level. Depths span B. grallator (878-4720 m) and B. longipes (2615-5610 m, 'widely scattered localities in the Pacific'). W Pacific OBIS records are B. guentheri/B. atricolor (Philippines); no Mariana record found.

diet: Small crustaceans (copepods, amphipods, isopods), bivalves, snails and bristle worms

visual.coloration: Semi-translucent, bell-shaped webbed body with two ear-like fins above the eyes.

adaptation: Flaps ear-like fins and uses cirri on its arms to waft tiny prey to the mouth.
notes: Mariana occurrence unconfirmed; OBIS W Pacific records ~23N 154E at 5.5-5.8 km depth.

notes: Deepest macrourid record: 7,012 m in the Mariana Trench (observed 4,506-7,012 m; trapped 4,441-6,081 m) (Linley et al. 2016).

adaptation: Mouthless and gutless; grows roots into bone to extract nutrients.
notes: Genus-level; 32+ species at 10-4000 m. No Mariana record found (OBIS W Pacific records off Japan, e.g. O. japonicus). Female size 2-7 cm.

visual.coloration: Elongate eel-like body, purplish-brown; slime glands along the flanks.

visual.coloration: Pinkish-red amphipod.

adaptation: Large scavenging amphipod; the holotype contained ingested microplastic.
notes: Described from baited traps at 6,010-6,949 m in the Mariana Trench (Weston et al. 2020). sizeMax is the genus maximum (154 mm).

adaptation: Thin, incompletely ossified bones, an open skull and an inflated stomach are among its adaptations to hadal depths.
